title: Sugarless
desc: Lovers Venkatesh and Mahalakshmi lead a happy life and are about to get married. But chaos ensues when Venkatesh is diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and decides to hide it from Mahalakshmi.

title: Thavarina Theru
desc: Sridhar, an orphaned villager with a quiet heart, finds love in Shruti, but their path forward is tangled in her deep sense of duty towards her struggling family.

title: Maryade Ramanna
desc: With the hope of beginning anew, a man returns to his village to sell a piece of his land. On the way, he falls in love with a young woman, only to find out later that her parents want him dead.

title: V
desc: A celebrated police officer's run of success is shockingly interrupted by V, a mysterious killer, who specifically challenges him to end his killing spree.

title: Rajahamsa
desc: Raj, born into a wealthy family and known for living life to the fullest, discovers a woman named Hamsa through a deceased man's diary. He finds himself falling in love with her.

title: Kannad Gothilla
desc: A senior crime inspector investigates a complex case of people going missing in Bengaluru, taking every measure possible to uncover the truth.

title: Duniya
desc: Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.
